subject: Entity remit, wiring instructions, and Net-terms decision for Meridian Health Order Form
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@meridianhealth.com>, procurement@meridianhealth.com
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Entity remit, wiring instructions, and Net-terms for Order Form

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the updated Order Form (v3). Before we route to procurement for signature we need three quick confirmations so our AP team can accept the documents and wire payments correctly:

1) Which Redwood legal entity will appear on the invoice and receive payment (US EIN and address)?
2) Can Redwood accept Net45 for this order (pilot + 12-month term)? Our standard is Net45 for strategic vendors.
3) We need a copy of the Redwood tax certificate (or W-9) and wire instructions for ACH/wire.

We have an internal PO ready but procurement requires the remit entity and tax evidence to be present on the Order Form before we pull PO/commit. Also note our tax team asked for confirmation on whether Redwood will treat these invoices as US-sourced (no VAT) or will invoice from an EU entity (VAT applicable).

Attached: current OrderForm_v3 from your team (we redlined a couple of fields). Please respond by EOD PT if possible — procurement is on a tight activation window.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager | Meridian Health
Lena Ortiz
[attachment: Meridian_OrderForm_v3_comments.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entity remit, wiring instructions, and Net-terms for Order Form

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the clear ask and for the redlines. Quick answers below and a couple of proposed options so we can keep the PO flow moving:

1) Invoice remit entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US)
   - EIN: 12-3456789
   - Address: 401 Redwood Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107
   - We will invoice from our US entity (no VAT).

2) Net terms: Our standard for self-serve customers is Net30, but for enterprise pilots we can accept Net45 for the initial 12-month term if Meridian agrees to a 1% early-payment discount (if paid within 15 days). If Net45 is mandatory without discount, finance has asked for a 30-day reserve (activation hold) until the first invoice clears.

3) Tax evidence & wires: attaching our W-9 / tax certificate and standard wire/ACH instructions.

Next steps I propose:
- We attach Redwood_Tax_Certificate_2028.pdf to the Order Form and populate the Invoice Remit block with the US entity details.
- Ben (cc’d) will prepare a short finance addendum capturing the Net45 vs Net30 fallback and the 1% early-pay discount option for the PO.
- If Meridian confirms remit to US entity and the PO number, we can update the OF and send for signature (DocuSign link included below).

I’ll loop Legal if you need any MSA redline changes for tax or remit language, but we think updating the Order Form and adding the W-9 should be sufficient.

DocuSign (pre-fill): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=prod&acct=ABC123&ppid=XYZ789

Thanks — aiming to get this wrapped today.

—Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
[attachment: Redwood_Tax_Certificate_2028.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@meridianhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>, procurement@meridianhealth.com
Date: Sat, 26 May 2028 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entity remit, wiring instructions, and Net-terms for Order Form

Kimberly / Ben —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the W-9. Meridian confirms we can accept invoices to Redwood Inference, Inc. for the US pilot (PO: MH-2028-0421).

Procurement prefers Net45 as our standard; we are ok with the 1% early-pay discount if Redwood wants to attach that as an incentive. Our tax team has reviewed and confirms that, since Redwood invoices from a US entity, VAT is not applicable. They did ask for a short line on the OF specifying "Invoice remit: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) — no VAT" for clarity.

Two small asks before we route to signature:
- Can Redwood remove the escrow clause in section 7.b? Our procurement counsel flags escrow as a blocker for PO routing.
- Please include wire details for ACH and a billing contact on the Invoice template (name + email).

Attaching our PO template and a short procurement checklist. If you can send an updated OF with the remit block and the early-pay discount clause and confirm escrow removal, we will push this through signature queue today.

Thanks,
Rajiv Menon
Senior Director, Vendor Mgmt | Meridian Health
[attachment: MH_PO_template.docx (docx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@meridianhealth.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 26 May 2028 17:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entity remit, wiring instructions, and Net-terms for Order Form

Rajiv / Lena —

Great — thanks for confirming PO MH-2028-0421 and for the VAT note. Per your asks we made three updates in the attached redline:

1) Invoice Remit block populated with: 
   Redwood Inference, Inc.
   EIN: 12-3456789
   401 Redwood Ave
   San Francisco, CA 94107
   Billing contact: Accounts Payable (invoices@redwoodinference.com)
   Wire/ACH: Redwood Inference, Inc. — Bank of SF — Routing: 012345678 — Acct: 0987654321

2) Early-pay discount clause: added optional clause — "1% discount if paid within 15 days; otherwise Net45 applies for the initial 12-month term." (Finance approved.)

3) Escrow: removed section 7.b per your procurement request; Legal reviewed and replaced with a limited service credit clause to preserve risk allocation (1.5% monthly SLA cap).

Attached: Meridian_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (redline) and a clean Order Form ready for prefill and DocuSign. If everything looks good on your side I will:
- Upload the clean OF to DocuSign and pre-fill the PO number and billing contact,
- Share the signing link to your procurement queue, and
- Trigger an invoice on acceptance for the activation month.

Marissa — can you confirm in the system the Net45 vs early-pay discount combo and set the billing workflow to route to the Meridian PO once signed? Jonas — please confirm the DocuSign prefill has the PO and billing email set.

If Meridian signs today we can aim for first invoice at the end of the month.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
[attachment: Meridian_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (pdf)]
